svg.title: Seven decades of Mars exploration as an event timeline
svg.desc: A horizontal timeline of 13 Mars-mission milestones from 1965 to a planned 2033, with alternating callouts above and below a central spine. Four coloured era bands group the missions: Flybys and Orbiters, First Landers, the Rover Age, and the planned Sample Return campaign.
svg.text: Sixty years of getting closer to Mars
From a 21-frame flyby to a rover caching rock for the trip home, each mission building on the last · daggered dates are planned

g.aria-label: 1965 — Mariner 4: First close-up photos of Mars on a flyby: 21 grainy frames.
g.title: 1965 — Mariner 4: First close-up photos of Mars on a flyby: 21 grainy frames.

g.aria-label: 1971 — Mariner 9: First spacecraft to orbit another planet; mapped 85% of Mars.
g.title: 1971 — Mariner 9: First spacecraft to orbit another planet; mapped 85% of Mars.

g.aria-label: 1976 — Viking 1: First fully successful landing; ran the first soil biology tests.
g.title: 1976 — Viking 1: First fully successful landing; ran the first soil biology tests.

g.aria-label: 1997 — Pathfinder: Airbag landing delivered Sojourner, the first Mars rover.
g.title: 1997 — Pathfinder: Airbag landing delivered Sojourner, the first Mars rover.

g.aria-label: 2004 — Spirit & Opportunity: Twin rovers found hard proof that liquid water once flowed.
g.title: 2004 — Spirit & Opportunity: Twin rovers found hard proof that liquid water once flowed.

g.aria-label: 2008 — Phoenix: Touched and confirmed water ice just under the polar soil.
g.title: 2008 — Phoenix: Touched and confirmed water ice just under the polar soil.

g.aria-label: 2012 — Curiosity: Sky-crane lander set down a car-sized nuclear lab in Gale crater.
g.title: 2012 — Curiosity: Sky-crane lander set down a car-sized nuclear lab in Gale crater.

g.aria-label: 2018 — InSight: First seismometer on Mars; recorded hundreds of marsquakes.
g.title: 2018 — InSight: First seismometer on Mars; recorded hundreds of marsquakes.

g.aria-label: 2021 — Perseverance: Began caching rock cores; Ingenuity flew the first Mars aircraft.
g.title: 2021 — Perseverance: Began caching rock cores; Ingenuity flew the first Mars aircraft.

g.aria-label: 2021 — Tianwen-1: China's Zhurong rover landed, a first on its debut Mars attempt.
g.title: 2021 — Tianwen-1: China's Zhurong rover landed, a first on its debut Mars attempt.
g.text: landed, a first on its debut

g.aria-label: 2028 (planned) — Sample Retrieval: Planned lander to gather Perseverance's cached tubes for launch.
g.title: 2028 (planned) — Sample Retrieval: Planned lander to gather Perseverance's cached tubes for launch.

g.aria-label: 2031 (planned) — Earth Return Orbiter: Planned relay to ferry the sealed samples back toward Earth.
g.title: 2031 (planned) — Earth Return Orbiter: Planned relay to ferry the sealed samples back toward Earth.

g.aria-label: 2033 (planned) — Samples on Earth: Target for the first Mars rocks to reach a lab on Earth.
g.title: 2033 (planned) — Samples on Earth: Target for the first Mars rocks to reach a lab on Earth.
g.text: rocks to reach a lab on

svg.text: Public mission history · future dates approximate
